registration_convention.nominal_transform: T_base_entity_nominal maps each workpiece-attached entity into base_link
registration_convention.parameterization: direct base-frame translation in meters plus base-frame rotation vector in radians; not an SE(3) twist with coupled translational exponential coordinates
registration_convention.quaternion_convention: right-handed rotation matrix; ROS quaternion order x,y,z,w
